name: Fresh 93% Lean / 7% Fat Ground Beef (Skillet-Browned)
whyItWorks: Extra-lean beef ground from round or sirloin cuts. When browned and drained, it leaves less than 5g fat per serving while providing concentrated heme iron and zinc to combat anemia.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Brown in a skillet, drain any released fat thoroughly on paper towels, and stir into soft white rice or gentle marinara.
